itemdesc-creature-horseplow: A two-horse plow. Hitch two adult horses, then drive the plow. A free backpack slot is required to pick it up and carry it.
horseplow:left-hitched: Horse attached to the left hitch.
horseplow:right-hitched: Horse attached to the right hitch.
horseplow:horse-already-hitched: That horse is already attached to a plow.
horseplow:team-full: Both hitch slots are already occupied.
itemdesc-workcollar: A draft collar for a horse. Required before a horse can be hitched to the Horse-Drawn Plow. To attach it, place the Work Collar in the horse's accessory slot beneath the neck.
horseplow:rope-first-horse: First, use <hk>rightmouse</hk> on a collared horse while holding the rope, then use <hk>rightmouse</hk> on the plow.
horseplow:rope-invalid: That rope connection is no longer valid.
horseplow:workcollar-required: That horse needs a Work Collar before it can be hitched to the plow.
horseplow:tooltip-unhitch-help: Remove the Work Collar to unhitch; use <hk>ctrl</hk> + <hk>rightmouse</hk> with an empty hand to release all horses.
horseplow:all-unhitched: All draft horses unhitched. Ropes returned.
horseplow:nothing-to-unhitch: No draft horses are currently hitched.
horseplow:horse-plowing-title: How to Use the Horse-Drawn Plow
horseplow:horse-plowing-text:
Preparing the team

Equip an adult horse with a Work Collar.
Hold a rope and use rightmouse on the horse.
While still holding the live end of the rope, use rightmouse on the Horse-Drawn Plow.
The horse will be attached and locked into one of the draft positions.
Repeat the process with a second collared horse on the other side.

Driving

Once both horses are attached, use rightmouse on the Horse-Drawn Plow to control it.

Plowing

The plow begins with its blades lowered. While standing beside the plow, use shift + rightmouse on it to raise or lower the blades. Soil is cultivated while moving forward with the blades lowered. The plowing speed depends on the horses hitched to the plow.

Unhitching

Remove a horse's Work Collar to unhitch that horse and return its rope. To release the entire team manually, use ctrl + rightmouse on the Horse-Drawn Plow with an empty hand.
horseplow:pickup-backpack-full: A free backpack slot is required to carry the Horse-Drawn Plow.
horseplow:pickup-dismount-first: Dismount the Horse-Drawn Plow before picking it up.
